evidence: The process of ALD MoS2 was shown in Fig.1, in which one ALD cycle contains four steps: pulse and purge MoCl5 precursor, pulse and purge H2S precursor by N2. Repeating these steps can obtain the MoS2 with desired thickness. The growth parameters are as follows: heating the chamber to 450 °C and keeping the pressure at 5.3 hundred Pa (hPa), placing the ultraclean substrates in the chamber and keeping for half an hour, heating the MoCl5 (99.6%) source to 200 °C, keeping H2S (99.6%) at room temperature under a base pressure of 8 hPa, pulsing and purging the precursors of MoCl5 and H2S into the ALD chamber alternately by N2 flows (99.999%) at a rate of 50 standard cubic centimeter per minute (sccm).
